name: Ústí nad Orlicí (Czechia)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:1:1, with three yellow discs arranged in a triangle in the upper blue.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 2 July 2024 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
